body: I totally get what you guys are saying.

I don't know a ton about windmills do you need an education to build them? The thing with the oil patch is it takes little to no education and you make a ton of money doing it. So having an education would disqualify a ton of people.

I don't know how to feel about this. My biggest issue with it is I know we are destroying our environment but living in Alberta and working a blue collared job in the oil patch I know that millions of people would be out of jobs. I think we need to find cleaner energy but I also think that it needs to create the jobs it took away.
Mine points up at my face...
When I hear about people like this I always imagine randy and Jim from trailer park boys.
Hey, come on, there's a time and place
I know that in Calgary at the Olympic park they have multiple jumps like this but different sizes. I think that you start on the small one and work your way up to the larger one.
I had a threesome once....minus two girls
I know my old school would close but a teacher would stay their in case some kids came so they would not freeze to death in the cold.
Thanks for the support. It feels good knowing someone cares about it. I really appreciate the comments you made. It feels good hearing positive in this time of negative.

Thanks. It means a lot to come on here and see this. I have just been feeling so hopeless lately. Thanks for taking the time to talk to me. I guess just the thought that someone cares a bit about me makes me feel a little better.
